text:
ellen.marketing: quick thread ":wave:" — after last week's launch spike i want a short mitigation plan for inbound blitzes. idea: lightweight "blitz gate" that runs enrichment-prefetch + tiny debounce so reps don't claim cold. keep RR weights identical.

raj-sdr: will this delay assignments? we had reps complain about waiting.

ellen.marketing: goal is non-blocking: if enrichment returns <1.5s we tag as blitz_prefetched and claim prefers it for 25s. otherwise no delay. no assignment priority changes.

kate-salesops: must avoid double-claims and field overwrites. propose writing all enrich data to temp props with timestamps and only promote on rep confirm or score>0.9.

hs-sync-bot: heads-up: will add HS props `blitz_prefetch_state`, `blitz_prefetch_ts`, `temp_company` and `blitz_score`. SF mapping update required.

sam-ops: small config for canary i can flip:
```json
{"feature":"routing.blitz_gate.v1","canary_pct":1,"enrich_wait_ms":1500,"prefer_window_ms":25000,"debounce_ms":500,"claim_lock_ms":35000}
```

omar-growth: cohort: campaign=big_launch OR leadscore>80. start 1% then 10% if metrics look good.

raj-sdr: add a tiny HUD badge in HS that flags temp fields, otherwise reps assume it's canonical.

kate-salesops: metrics to watch: `blitz_prefetch_hit_rate`, `claims_with_prefetch_before_claim_pct`, `rr_fairness_index`, `claim_latency_p95_ms`, `manual_promote_rate`. rollback if rr_fairness_index degrades >12% or claim_latency_p95 worsens >20%.

sam-ops: pushing to staging now, prod canary 7pm PT. i'll post +10m and +1h smoke in #handoff-sla.

elllen.marketing: thanks all (note: small typo in name above) — quick sync Fri 9am PT to decide widen/rollback. :rocket:
